name: reasonable-rust-builds
description: Keep Rust/cargo builds fast and target dirs from eating tens of GBs (debuginfo, test binaries, artifact sets, worktrees), with `wt` for warm task worktrees whose targets prune to what is in use. Use when starting a Rust project, reorganizing a Rust repo's build/test/worktree workflow, or when builds are slow or target/ disk use is a problem.
